title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits China's Tibet region, killing 16 people
paragraphs: A magnitude-7 earthquake has struck China's south-western region of Tibet, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others, state news agency Xinhua has reported.
Citing Nagqu City's emergency management bureau, Xinhua reported the earthquake struck about 10:33pm Thursday, local time.
As of 2:25am on Friday, 11 of the injured were in serious condition while 21 sustained minor injuries, Xinhua reported.
